_why: NIGHT67 T1a (Tools/night/gen-slots.cjs --level iceline --export): n52-iceline's room g4 (2.4 THE REACH) exactly as Design/levels/n52/iceline.plan.json has it: the row (every key), its zone-keyed pieces (boxes, ramps, pads, grapple, pits, tunnels), its room-keyed pieces (lights, props, surfaces). The slot's starting point: rebuild it here (every new piece with a job and a why), give the row bot43: false, verb65 (the slate's verb) and line65 (the verb's line, 3+ waypoints); never an area67 block (refused). A key the row drops needs a reason in drop{}. The room's opening: top-level "opening": "vista" | "ambushed" | "ambusher" | "held" (and "opening_why"); left out, the room keeps n52-iceline's.

row.name: 2.4 THE REACH
row.verb36: the glove cannot reach a flyer: punch its orb back at it; ride the lock walls over the canal, take the hoist to the gallery and meet the drones at their height
row.iceline46_why: NIGHT46 A3 I-1: the east bridge x 6..9 over the canal (2 crossings, a loop); the drones, their nodes, the lesson and the NW ledge unchanged

frames52._why: NIGHT52 the room frames reel a452 (FeelReel.N52.Rooms.cs): entry, the fight live, the highest tier

row.loop52_why: NIGHT52 the room loop (Tools/night/n52-loop-g4.cjs; THE ROOM CONTRACT's spirit, a teach room: the enemy-types item exempt): n47's THE REACH rebuilt as THE REACH II: 24 x 30 x 10 m; 19 pieces; three tiers (floor, the 2 m NW ledge, the 4 m NE gallery, each on a walkers' ramp); two 17.5 m lock walls over the canal; the canal hoist and the return hoist (pads); the lesson and the waves kept. Fix 6 (n52-loop-fix6.cjs): the canal hoist in the east ride's pocket, the NW ramp flush to the wall. NIGHT53 (n53-loop-g4.cjs): the mirror broken: the east lock wall runs on to the gallery (24 m), the west wall and run-up cut, a sluice head and a canal stone in the west, the west post 3 m west, the first drone off-axis west, the canal lit from below.
